participation.context: Answered the litany, did not look, and lost the sermon.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the filled aisle and the three pews, and carried the cushion home.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Gave the litany, and a sermon that did not stay.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Answered short and cold from his pew, and did not look across.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

participation.context: A dark head under a plain hood in the north aisle. It did not turn, and it did not speak.
participation.name: the lady of the parish

story.body: You gave the litany its answers beside hers. You did not look at the Mayor's pew. You came away with nothing from the sermon, and with the pulse in the jaw.

title: Stood three pews from the Mayor

participation.context: Ate on the quiet side, and brought no page to the table.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Measured the thumb, and refused a house fed on hints.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Named the left side, and put the rest under the cloth.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Not the dinner. Left where he was.
participation.name: Gib

relations.note: the loaf and the notch are hers to read
relations.quote: A full thumb short, and the price is still a penny.

story.body: You took three bites of a penny loaf. You left the sermon where it was, which was nowhere you could repeat.

relations.note: the loaf and the notch are hers to read
relations.quote: A full thumb short, and the price is still a penny.

title: Ate the soft of the penny loaf with Mistress Ansell and Alse

participation.context: Set the cross, and left the rest of the table empty.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You marked the day and you did not write a word beside it.

title: Set a cross against the fourteenth
